fieldCam.pan_response: 0 = stuck to the screen. 1 = 1:1 with the world
fieldCam.zoom_response: How much the camera zoom affects the pattern
fieldCam.enabled: Hides the drawing without taking it off the stack

oneLiners.st#globais: Global bag of the game's state.
oneLiners.canvas#globais: The window: camera, post, background, views.
oneLiners.init#init: Design space, window_scale and display. No OS window yet.
oneLiners.run#script-minimo: Enters the loop. run(Title) starts with the class Title(Act).
oneLiners.clock#frame-clock: Game time. Name it in a lambda.
oneLiners.keyp#frame-teclado: Keyboard: held, not the moment of the press.
oneLiners.mouse#frame-mouse: The pointer. Name mouse in a lambda.
oneLiners.recently#agendar-recently: Remembers a moment for a time window.
oneLiners.Cancelled#agendar-handle: Cancelled Handle or wait. BaseException — except Exception does not catch it.
oneLiners.on_mode#mode-enter: Decorator: this method is a mode.
oneLiners.run_task#mode-task: Runs an async sequence alongside everything else (a task).
oneLiners.wait#mode-async: Waits N seconds in an async mode.
oneLiners.until_empty#mode-async: Waits for the group to empty. Do not use until(group.empty).
oneLiners.set_watchdog#mode-async: Turns the freeze watchdog on or off.
oneLiners.Act#atos-classe: One part of the game (title, level, end): class Play(Act). What it creates leaves with it.
oneLiners.change_act#atos-trocar: Leaves the current act and enters another, at once. Always a new one (restart).
oneLiners.Sound#som-play: Audio data. Does not play on its own.
oneLiners.Microphone#som-mic: Microphone capture; record() returns a Sound.
oneLiners.play_sound#som-play: Plays a path, Sound or Microphone. Returns a Handle.
oneLiners.LowPass#som-fx: Low-pass filter on a sound Handle.
oneLiners.HighPass#som-fx: High-pass filter on a sound Handle.
oneLiners.Echo#som-fx: Echo. The tail goes into the bake.
oneLiners.Reverb#som-fx: Reverb. The tail goes into the bake.
oneLiners.chase#util-chase: Chases the target with an exponential lag.
oneLiners.approach#util-approach: Moves to the target at constant speed and arrives exactly.
oneLiners.deadzone#util-deadzone: Slack: moves only when the target leaves the box.
oneLiners.show_tracks#debug-metodos: Debug: overlay of the active move_along tracks.
oneLiners.show_processes#debug-metodos: Debug: panel of the running tasks and modes (Ctrl+Shift+6).
oneLiners.collision.show_colliders#debug-metodos: Debug: overlay of the registered hitboxes (green detection, gold resolve).
oneLiners.DerivedAttributeError#erros-catalogo: Tried to write a derived field.
oneLiners.ParallaxLayerError#erros-catalogo: Click or collision on a parallax layer.
oneLiners.UiLayerError#erros-catalogo: Collision or SpatialFx on the ui layer.
oneLiners.click#reagir-pointer: A click on the object or the Button.
oneLiners.hover#ptr-hover: The cursor entered: it became the hover target.
oneLiners.hover_exit#ptr-hover: It stopped being the hover target.
oneLiners.when#reagir-when: @when: runs when it turns from False to True.
oneLiners.drag_to#reagir-pointer: The drag of this shape was released.
oneLiners.drop_by#reagir-pointer: Something was dropped on this target.
oneLiners.heading#geo-helpers: Angle from a → b, in degrees.
oneLiners.closest_point#geo-helpers: Point on the filled body nearest to p.
oneLiners.Level#colocar-fase: Reads a level from the editor. Creates nothing; make() does.
oneLiners.move_to#pose-move-to: Absolute place. x/y, Vec2 or Point. Without time= or speed= it places; with one of them it travels.
oneLiners.move_by#pose-move-by: Delta: dx/dy, Vec2 or angle=/distance=. Always travels; time= or speed=.
oneLiners.move_along#mover-move-along: Travels a curve. time= is one lap; or speed= (units per second).
oneLiners.rotate_to#pose-rotate-to: Absolute heading; speed= in degrees/s. On a Box: changes it in place, no time=.
oneLiners.rotate_by#pose-rotate-by: Signed delta; speed= in degrees/s. On a Box: changes it in place, no time=.
oneLiners.Button#ui-button: Button. Its 1st argument is the bound field.
oneLiners.SpriteButton#ui-sprite-button: A game button made from your art (hover, press, turned off).
oneLiners.Slider#ui-slider: A slider tied to an Attribute.
oneLiners.CheckBox#ui-checkbox: Turns a bool Attribute on and off.
oneLiners.TextInput#ui-textinput: Text box. When focused, it takes the keys.
oneLiners.Menu#ui-menu: A game question. Closes on a choice.
